title: The invoice is in the DM
scenario: A seller you follow sends an “invoice” in a DM for a limited hoodie drop. The button opens a payment page asking for your card plus your email password “to confirm the order account.”

answers.A: Pay if the card page looks secure, but leave the email-password field blank.
answers.B: Buy only through the seller’s verified storefront or platform checkout; never enter your email password into a shop payment page.
answers.C: Ask the seller to send the product link through their public profile/store instead of the DM.

explanation: A shop should not need your email password. DM invoices bypass the protections of the normal storefront.
proTip: Payment pages need payment data—not your inbox key.
